name: Stratholme: Hearthsinger Forresten does not respawn five minutes after his death (COA-5667)
contract: Hearthsinger Forresten (10558, guid 9950081) is a CoA-placed Stratholme boss. Like the other CoA boss spawns there (The Unforgiven 9950080/9970179, Magistrate Barthilas 9950286, Timmy the Cruel 9950289) he kept a 300 s respawn, because the vanilla respawn pass skipped CoA spawns, so he came back during the same run. The stock Stratholme bosses use 86400 s. Killed, he must still be dead 5 min 15 s later.

steps.label: Wait past the old 300 s respawn
